environment.browser: user's own Chrome, logged in to ChatGPT, zh-CN UI, Team workspace account
environment.method: opencli browser sessions; page operated by OpenCLI click/type; responses read from OpenCLI network capture; no request was constructed by the probe

redaction: No cookies, tokens, account identity, conversation ids, or other conversation titles are recorded. Sizes are response body bytes as reported by OpenCLI.
prompt: 用不超过 500 字总结：截至 2026 年，Rust 异步运行时 async-std 的维护状态，以及其官方推荐的替代方案。

timeline_utc.plan_card_visible: within 15 s of sending; the host model thought for 4 s and called the Deep Research app tool at 13:11:48
timeline_utc.countdown: button 开始 with a countdown of about 60 s; not clicked
timeline_utc.report_seen_complete: 13:18:34 poll (previous poll at about 13:16:20 was still running)

tool_selection.deep_research_url: /deep-research loads, then the client rewrites the path to /
tool_selection.composer_mode: a 聊天 / 工作 toggle (aria-label 撰写器模式); 深度研究 is only in the 聊天 mode menu
tool_selection.menu_button: aria-label 添加文件等内容; no data-testid composer-plus-btn
tool_selection.selected_marker: an inline mention span in the composer with app-mention-path app://connector_openai_deep_research
tool_selection.typing_caveat: OpenCLI type replaced the composer content and removed the mention; the mention was inserted again after the text
tool_selection.draft_caveat: composer content persists as a draft across page loads

conversation_read.endpoint: GET /backend-api/conversations/<id>?num_turns=10&include_has_versions=true, requested by the page itself when /c/<id> opens
conversation_read.window: OpenCLI background window; document.hidden was false
conversation_read.shape: flat messages[] list with page_info cursors; no mapping tree
turn_messages: assistant text (short notice that deep research started; not the report)

tool_response_metadata.venus_widget_state.status: waiting_for_user_response_on_plan (snapshot at tool call time; does not change)

widget_state.step_statuses: running: all pending; completed: completed x3, in_progress x1 (not reliable as a completion signal)

report_message.author: assistant, metadata.real_author tool:web
report_message.body: content.parts[0], Markdown, 830 characters; written in Traditional Chinese although the prompt was Simplified Chinese
report_message.citation_markers: U+E200 cite U+E202 turnNsearchM|turnNviewM ... U+E201; 5 markers, 15 ids, 12 unique
report_message.content_references: 6 entries: 5 grouped_webpages (start_idx/end_idx match the marker span exactly; items[0] has title, url, attribution, pub_date, snippet; safe_urls lists every cited URL, each also with a ?utm_source=chatgpt.com variant) and 1 sources_footnote (3 sources)
report_message.search_result_groups: 26 groups; entries carry ref_id {turn_index, ref_type, ref_index}; only 3 of 12 cited ids resolve through them
report_message.cited_urls: 12 unique direct URLs (no redirect links); count of non-utm safe_urls per marker equals the id count of that marker

progress_channel.endpoint: POST /backend-api/ecosystem/call_mcp, sent by the widget iframe (web-sandbox.oaiusercontent.com, app=skybridge)
progress_channel.response: _meta.deep_research_widget_messages (reasoning titles, search queries, web.run calls) and _meta.source_searches (domain, url, titles[].items[] with snippet)
progress_channel.observed: running: 32 messages, 60 source searches, 133 KB; completed: 35 messages, 150 source searches, 303 KB
